nodes.description: The recurrent p.Ser605del removes one serine from motif A of the POLD1 polymerase active site. The mutant holoenzyme cannot extend a primer, while its 3'-5' exonuclease activity is reduced only 1.7- to 2.5-fold, so it still binds DNA. Molecular dynamics predicts impaired dNTP binding at the DNA-binding site. Preserved DNA binding raised the possibility that the mutant competes with the wild-type polymerase, which has not been tested. Missense alleles map near the exonuclease-polymerase interface (Arg507) or to the C-terminal CysB iron-sulphur cluster region.
